primary_analysis: Confirmatory paired analysis of per-intent binary failure flags using the preregistered paired estimand: compute P(failure | baseline) and P(failure | guarded) across the 400 paired intents; report the paired difference (Guarded − Baseline) with 95% bootstrap confidence interval and perform McNemar test (two-sided, α=0.05) as specified in the preregistration; use adapter-provided deterministic scorers (execution/scoring/*.json) and RNG seed=42; apply failed-call treatment = complete_pair_primary.
secondary_analyses: Confirmatory summaries of outage-duration distribution by condition: mean, median, IQR, and empirical skewness using outage_duration_seconds from execution/raw_results.jsonl (nonparametric two-sample tests where applicable).
Confirmatory rollback rates: rollback count per 100 intents by condition (aggregate from execution scoring artifacts).
Confirmatory vendor- and change-type subgroup analyses: per-vendor and per-change-type failure proportions by condition with BH FDR (0.05) correction as preregistered.
sensitivity_analyses: Pairwise exclusion sensitivity per preregistered missingness_plan: apply preregistered persistent-infrastructure exclusion rule (none recorded in execution_manifest) and re-run primary paired test.

Failed-call treatment sensitivity: re-run primary estimand treating any adapter-recorded failed model/provider calls as baseline-failure=1 (contract identifier: complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity used only as a sensitivity alternative) and report impact on point estimate and p-value.
Imputation sensitivity for excluded pairs per preregistered plan: report results with multiple imputation and with worst-case/best-case pairwise imputations (labeled exploratory when applied).
uncertainty_quantification: Primary: 95% bootstrap confidence intervals for paired difference and McNemar exact p-value; secondary: nonparametric bootstrap/CI for medians and means, Kaplan–Meier confidence bands for time-to-recovery plots (per preregistered analysis scripts stored with hashes in execution_manifest). All uncertainty measures computed deterministically by the registered analysis scripts using the adapter-provided scorers and raw results.
multiplicity_implementation: One prespecified primary hypothesis/test only. All secondary and subgroup tests controlled with Benjamini–Hochberg FDR (q=0.05) as preregistered. Exploratory analyses explicitly labeled exploratory and not subject to confirmatory multiplicity control.
contamination_analysis: Follow preregistered exact/near-duplicate detection on the stored task_manifest (execution/task_manifest.jsonl). Any contaminated intents would be excluded pairwise per preregistration. Execution_manifest reports completed_episode_count=800 and failed_episode_count=0 and records no pairwise exclusions; therefore contamination exclusions = none (manifest and hashes provided). All contamination-detection code and flags preserved in execution artifacts.
table_specifications: Table 1 — Primary paired outcome table: for N=400 intents show counts and proportions of failures by condition, paired-difference (Guarded−Baseline), 95% bootstrap CI, and McNemar two-sided p-value; include exact N, number of validator-rejects, number of repair attempts (from execution/result_schema files).
Table 2 — Outage-duration summary: for failed intents by condition report N_failed, mean, median, IQR, 90th/99th percentiles, and counts of long-tail failures; include per-condition sample sizes.
Table 3 — Rollbacks: rollback count and rate per 100 intents by condition; include 95% binomial CIs.

Table 4 — Subgroup results: vendor (VendorA/B/C) and change-type (ACL/Routing/Monitoring) failure proportions by condition, raw counts, proportion differences, and BH-adjusted p-values for subgroup comparisons.
figure_specifications: Figure 1 — Outage-duration distribution: overlaid kernel density estimates and boxplots (log-scaled) by condition (Baseline vs Guarded) using outage_duration_seconds from scoring outputs.

Figure 2 — Kaplan–Meier plot of time-to-recovery for failed intents by condition with 95% confidence bands (as preregistered); censoring per deterministic recovery criteria recorded in scoring artifacts.

Figure 3 — Pipeline Sankey/flow diagram: counts of shared-initial→validator pass/reject→repair attempted→applied→failure outcomes (constructed from execution/transformation_manifest.json and execution/scoring/*.json).
